context:
Goal: reviews end as soon as a change is proven safe.
Problem (rule): R9 says a guard or check change that passes round 1 is done, and only one fixed under a fix check waits for round 3. On #3185, round 1 passed, then lint-only edits (no finding fixed) went under a fix verifier, and `merge --reviewed` now says it owes the final round. The coordinator first told the lane it was done, then corrected to the tool's reading: round 3 runs. R9 does not say whether a lint-only fix counts as 'fixed under a fix check'. It needs your word.
Based on (ruling): R9 (your 15:44 CST Nov 10, pick 471 a); your 11:40 CST Nov 13 words 'do we still force round 3 reviews on certain items? ... that shouldnt be teh case anymore'.
Based on (read): the coordinator's report on #3185.
Departs from: main — the tool counts any fix check as a fixed change; a counts a lint-only fix as not fixed.
Meanwhile: lanes follow the tool's reading (round 3 runs). Not blocking.
home: ruling R9 (pick 471 a); steps rounds-rules-one-record, merge-reviewed-cursor

lastAnswer.note: pretty sure all skip after the round that passes them? message retrospective

options.gain: No third round for a lint-only edit.
options.how: If round 1 passed and the only later edits fix lint (no finding was fixed), the change is done at the passing fix check. `merge --reviewed` stops saying it owes the final round.
options.label: Lint-only fixes after a round-1 PASS skip round 3
options.lose: The tool must tell a lint-only edit from a finding fix, and a wrong call merges a guard change without round 3.

options.how: R9 as the tool reads it: a change with a fix verifier waits for round 3, whatever the fix was.
options.label: Keep round 3 for any fix check, as the tool reads it today
options.lose: A lint-only edit costs a full extra Sonnet round.

reply: Filed 13:23 CST: your 741 a is ruling own-741-a-lint-fix-no-r3. A lint-only fix after a round-1 pass skips round 3. Your question, whether every change skips round 3 once a round passes it, went to the retrospective; I bring its answer.

shown.label: Lint-only fixes after a round-1 PASS skip round 3
Keep round 3 for any fix check, as the tool reads it today

title: After a round-1 PASS, should a lint-only fix (no finding fixed) skip round 3?
why: R9 is your ruling; the lint-only case is a gap it does not name.
